rationale: The description specifies a web application for policy creation, distribution, publication, education, enforcement, browser access, and search, which is conventional policy workflow functionality without an affirmative AI/ML signal.
evidence_spans: a Web-based application that automates and manages the complete cycle of creation, distribution, publication, education and enforcement of corporate policies and procedures.

Users will be able to access the policies and procedures through a regular Internet browser. This method provides a user-friendly interface that allows users to read all the policies available to them or to search for a specific policy.
